defect: The new validity checks use the sel_p index directly (format.unified.validity.RowIsValid(index) and the keys/children/values/data validity asserts) without mapping it through format.unified.sel or each component's sel, so Verify reads wrong validity entries and fires spurious assertions for dictionary or constant VARIANT vectors.
reason: The fix maps the row through format.unified.sel and each component's sel before exactly the validity checks this change added; the unmapped data lookups were older, but the added checks are new and wrong.

defect: The new non-union branch dereferences result->initial_reader, which is null when auto_detect is off, and Flush now indexes insert_cols_idx, which COPY FROM and other readers never populate.
reason: The fix removes these population loops and lets Flush fill insert_cols_idx itself when empty, repairing the crash and out-of-bounds access this change introduced (copy csv test).

defect: The fix only moves the n < tuple_count assertion into the (block_idx, tuple_idx) overload added later; the actual bug fixed by that commit is a comparison in sort_key.hpp.
reason: No defect in this change's lines is repaired; the block_iterator edit is an assertion improvement on later code.

defect: The fix comments out the CommonAggregateOptimizer call this change added, disabling the optimizer for now without naming a defect.
reason: The disabling may hide a bug in the CA optimizer implementation in another file or be unrelated to correctness; neither the fix nor the repository shows which.

defect: The fix ports the R binding to the later SQLTypeId / TypeId::DOUBLE type system; at the change TypeId::DECIMAL was DuckDB's double type and the code matched the API.
reason: Adaptation to a later type-system refactor, not a repair of a defect in this change.

defect: The fix removes the v1.4-only temporary ExtractCTENodes workaround declaration while merging v1.4 into main, where the CTE binding rework made it obsolete.
reason: Branch reconciliation that removes an intentional temporary workaround, not a defect repair.

defect: The fix deletes the whole temporary v1.4 CTE (de)serialization workaround, including EraseDuplicateCTE, during the v1.4-to-main merge and uses generated serialization instead.
reason: The code was marked as not meant for main; removing it on merge is reconciliation, not a fix of a defect in these lines.

defect: The new extra_info property 212 is written unconditionally and read with the required ReadProperty, so plans serialized without it fail to deserialize and older readers meet an unexpected field, breaking serialization compatibility.
reason: The fix switches to WritePropertyWithDefault and ReadPropertyWithExplicitDefault, the standard pattern for new fields, in exactly the lines this change added.

defect: The fix only re-wraps the over-long constructor initializer line added by this change.
reason: Pure formatting fix.

defect: The fix removes the unneeded string.h include added by this change.
reason: Style cleanup, no defect.

defect: The fix reformats the ExpressionRootInfo constructor initializer list and moves name into extra_info.
reason: Formatting and a trivial move, no behavioural defect.

defect: The new EncodeDouble special cases encode -infinity (and NaN) with hand-built bit patterns that do not sort correctly against the encoded finite keys (and use the overflowing int shift 1 << 31), so ART keys for infinities are misordered.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these infinity branches, introduced here for doubles, with the order-preserving extremes 0 and ULLONG_MAX and drops the NaN special case.

defect: The fix rewrites the floating-point ART tests to insert Key::EncodeFloat/EncodeDouble encodings as BIGINT and adds a generic full_scan helper.
reason: Test-only change.

defect: The fix corrects the copy-pasted doc comment of duckdb_destroy_instance_cache.
reason: Documentation fix.

defect: For constant filter expressions the change calls AddBinding(*column_ref), which stores a reference to the loop-local BoundColumnRefExpression in column_references, leaving a dangling reference once column_ref is destroyed at the end of the iteration.
reason: The follow-up commits first keep column_ref alive and then replace the constant expression by column_ref itself so the stored reference stays valid; the dangling reference lies in the lines added here.

defect: The fix resolves merge-conflict markers between this clang-tidy edit (final instead of final override) and another branch's new declarations.
reason: Merge-conflict resolution, not a defect in this change.

defect: The output buffer is sized from expr.children[0]->stats.maximum_string_length without checking that statistics are available, so inputs without string statistics overflow the heap buffer (only a debug assert guards it).
reason: The fix sizes the buffer from strlen when stats are missing, replacing exactly the line this change introduced (the old code used the length argument's stats instead).

defect: The fix replaces next_size_t<...>(-1) << n with a cast of 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF to silence a shift-of-negative-value warning.
reason: Warning fix with unchanged semantics; the same sign-extension shift pattern existed in the pre-change code.

defect: The change writes first_segment, last_segment and total_capacity through a LinkedList pointer at an unaligned offset inside the segment (header plus capacity bools plus list entries), a misaligned access that is undefined behaviour.
reason: The fix replaces these direct writes with Store<LinkedList> as part of fixing pointer alignment issues; the misaligned LinkedList initialisation comes from this change.

defect: The fix relaxes the new D_ASSERT on the scanned vector type from full LogicalType equality to id() and removes a commented-out line.
reason: The scanned collection is always created with plain VARCHAR, so the stricter assertion could not fire; the edit is cosmetic.

defect: The binder accepts any query column whose physical type is VARCHAR (for example BLOB) for CREATE TYPE ... AS ENUM (query), although only VARCHAR columns are valid enum sources for the operator.
reason: The fix tightens the check to the VARCHAR logical type id, repairing the too-loose type check this change added.

defect: The fix stops serializing the schema separately and looks the schema up from the base info's catalog and schema name.
reason: The serialization design (schema info serialized, INVALID_CATALOG lookup) predates this pointer-to-reference refactor.

defect: The fix moves the source-state locking onto the sink lock (internal issue 1857) and adds double casts in the thread_limit expression this change touched.
reason: The race lies in pre-existing locking code; the touched line only gets a conversion-warning tweak.

defect: The new hugeint and uhugeint to VARINT casts size the lower 64 bits by their value even when the upper word is nonzero, dropping the lower word's leading zero bytes and producing wrong values (e.g. 2^64+1), and test the wrong word against UINT64_MAX before log2(lower+1).
reason: The fix writes all 8 lower bytes whenever upper bytes exist; the HUGEINT cast path with this logic was wired up by this change.

defect: After moving UPDATE expressions behind a projection, BindExtraColumns still binds the extra CHECK/index columns directly against the table, so the LogicalUpdate gets expressions referencing bindings its projection child does not output.
reason: The fix rewrites BindExtraColumns to route the extra columns through the get and the projection, repairing the inconsistent bindings this refactor introduced.

defect: The fix redesigns the TopNWindowElimination header (BaseColumnPruner base class, renamed helpers) as part of ongoing feature work.
reason: API redesign of a work-in-progress optimizer; no defect in this header change.

defect: The new LOGICAL_AGGREGATE_AND_GROUP_BY case in TryLateMaterialization never advances child to its child, so the while loop revisits the same aggregate forever (and it assumes expressions[0] is a function with two children).
reason: The fix removes the UNNEST and AGGREGATE cases added here, eliminating the infinite loop.

defect: The fix reworks TopN window elimination (projection creation, group index mapping, row number generation) on top of this change's group_offset and group_idxs edits.
reason: This WIP change's lines are rewritten, but the clear mapping bug the fix repairs (the struct path projecting the first n groups) predates it, and whether its own edits were wrong cannot be determined.

defect: The fix puts the delim scan after the plan in the cross product so the delim columns follow the existing columns under set operations.
reason: The delim-first order was already used by the manual cross product that this change replaced with LogicalCrossProduct::Create.

defect: The null_padding plus quoted-newline guard only fires when iterator.done (the last row of a thread), so quoted newlines elsewhere in a parallel null_padding scan go undetected and can yield misparsed rows.
reason: The fix drops the iterator.done condition this change introduced and errors on any quoted newline in a parallel null_padding scan.

defect: The fix removes an extra blank line from the unterminated-quote error message.
reason: Message formatting only.

defect: The fix makes the QualifyBinder a local and copies its bound columns so it does not outlive the QUALIFY binding (interaction with LATERAL joins).
reason: The long-lived unique_ptr<QualifyBinder> predates this change, which only dropped the bind_state argument.

defect: The fix changes the index type from int to size_t (sign-compare warning) and removes a debugging std::cout from ParseExplanation in the test runner.
reason: Warning and debug-output cleanup in test tooling; no wrong result.

defect: The reusable dictionary is always created with dictionary_size + 1 entries and result.Dictionary(dictionary, sel) now reports that size, so a column without NULLs exposes an uninitialized extra dictionary entry (previously the size passed was dictionary_size + can_have_nulls).
reason: The fix sizes the dictionary as dictionary_size + can_have_nulls, repairing the size this change introduced.

defect: The fix resets the column validity masks to build_size and resets the bitmap when the build is dense, adapting to the reusable-dictionary rework (b8a33a2) made in between.
reason: No defect in this change's mask-combine lines is repaired; the fix hardens code after a later refactor.

defect: LikeClause now parses its right-hand side as a full Expression instead of OtherOperatorExpression, so LIKE binds looser than AND, OR and comparisons and swallows the rest of the expression.
reason: The fix restores OtherOperatorExpression, reverting exactly this change's precedence error.

defect: When copying from a partially overlapping cached range, Read neither advances current_location and remaining_bytes after the memcpy nor recomputes buffer_offset after reading the gap, so later reads write at wrong offsets and re-read bytes.
reason: The fix recomputes buffer_offset and advances the counters after the memcpy in the code this change added.

defect: The fix replaces the three CSVState members with a CSVStates struct.
reason: Refactor.

defect: The fix changes Transition to operate on a CSVStates struct.
reason: Refactor.

defect: The fix ports ParseValues to CSVStates and Transition and drops the state != EMPTY_LINE conditions after later state machine changes.
reason: The logic was moved unchanged from the sniffer's type detection; the fix adapts it to later refactors.
